mintAuthority.summary: Native issuance remains under issuer authority. ZARU has a System Program Solana signer and the same EOA with mint/admin/upgrader powers on three EVM chains.

controls.label: Solana Token-2022 mint authority
controls.evidence: A single finalized getMultipleAccounts response at slot 453523097 binds the Token-2022 mint to sole mintAuthority 8USLqNrJ6WfUcTk2XUBYGRiMA2Mp2qh9AhsJZBEg5W62 and this nonexecutable, zero-data System Program account. This is not an SPL multisig or PDA; jsonParsed instruction labels do not establish a quorum. Archival history reaches creation slot 373091718 (2025-10-13): all 854 transactions were retrieved, with 39 mintToChecked instructions using this sole signer and 24 burnChecked instructions. Mint less burn exactly equals pinned supply 60552996194140 base units. No native numeric issuance cap, independently verified HSM custody or human independence is established.

controls.label: ethereum MINTER_ROLE and role administrator
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26110191, additionally verified BURNER_ROLE, CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE and SALVAGE_ROLE are true for this EOA. Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history through block 26110183 returned eight grants to this sole address and no revocations, covering DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER, PAUSER, RECOVERY, BURNER, CONTRACT_ADMIN, SALVAGE and UPGRADER. Verified ERC20F source gates mint only by MINTER_ROLE, with no quantitative cap; _authorizeUpgrade is immediate UPGRADER_ROLE. accessRegistry() is 0xfa51dd24f7348d5f0e6c5a5a00213d85ca401da9. Role administration and upgrades can expand issuance, without independently established human quorum or HSM custody.

controls.label: base MINTER_ROLE and role administrator
controls.evidence: Full Base RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history through block 52110948 returned eight grants to this sole EOA and no revocations, including BURNER_ROLE, CONTRACT_ADMIN_ROLE and SALVAGE_ROLE as well as DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER, UPGRADER, RECOVERY and PAUSER. Current BURNER and CONTRACT_ADMIN membership was independently confirmed at the pin; SALVAGE's full-history grant was observed but a fresh membership call was rate-limited. Verified ERC20F source has immediate role-gated mint and UUPS upgrades, with no numeric cap. accessRegistry() at block 52110830 is 0xfa51dd24f7348d5f0e6c5a5a00213d85ca401da9. No signer-independence or HSM attestation is inferred.

controls.label: arc MINTER_ROLE and role administrator
controls.evidence: Arc's topic-filtered explorer histories terminate with eight RoleGranted events to this sole EOA and no RoleRevoked events. The explorer indexing tail is closed by 27 successful 500-block Dwellir queries from block 24347185 through pinned block 24360273, with no role changes. At that pin all eight memberships are true and all role administrators are DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; the EOA is codeless. EIP-1967 points to ERC20F 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62. Its pinned executable matches the Sourcify-recompiled runtime byte-for-byte after substituting five exact __self immutables and removing trailing CBOR metadata. Source gates uncapped mint by MINTER_ROLE and immediate UUPS replacement by UPGRADER_ROLE. No human independence or HSM custody is inferred.

review.evidence: Reviewed native issuance on October 5, 2026. Arc's terminal eight-grant/zero-revoke explorer history plus a successful 27-window indexing-tail census establishes the sole eight-role EOA through block 24360273. All current Arc memberships and default-admin relationships are pinned. Ethereum/Base earlier complete role inventories remain sourced; current implementation slots and codeless authority are corroborated at Ethereum 26124902, Base 52199351 and Arc 24360273. Each chain's deployed ERC20F executable equals Sourcify's recompiled source runtime: substitute the observed 32-byte __self address at byte offsets 3167, 3231, 3585, 3649 and 3792, then remove only the final 53-byte CBOR section. All 15620 executable bytes agree; no other normalization is used. Unbounded immediate mint/admin/upgrade economics are retained. Incident review searched issuer home, whitepaper, legal and blog disclosures, published audit claims, indexed issuer X, rekt.news and exploit searches. Direct X access was blocked and the whitepaper promises rather than supplies a contract audit. All 854 archival Solana mint-address transactions through finalized slot 453523097 were fetched without errors, reaching creation slot 373091718. The 39 mints all use the identified sole issuer signer; 24 burns yield the exact pinned supply 60552996194140 base units. Terminal Ethereum/Base/Arc Transfer histories show one 100-token mint and corresponding burn on each chain; each mint/burn caller is the identified role EOA and all three pinned current supplies are zero. No active or resolved native unauthorized-mint incident was identified in this review. This is not financial backing assurance or a custody-independence claim. The latest public report signed August 28 covers only the July 31 snapshot and explicitly states ISRS 4400 AUP is not an assurance engagement, so recurring current reconciliation and attestation-only supervision are not established. FSCA's official site/register redirects to its ICT-maintenance notice; FSP55172 scope remains unverified. Reconciliation and supervision stay unknown, and all named key-custody questions remain open.
